name: Squirrel Internet
summary: Brisbane ISP (Squirrel Internet / Squirrel Net; Squirrel Software Technologies Pty Ltd, 11 Quindus St, Wacol QLD; later Level 30, Riverside Centre, 123 Eagle St, Brisbane CBD - known for a live webcam of the Brisbane CBD and a 1,200-shop shopping portal). Same business as Ozenetcom (oznetcom.com.au, AS9382): The It Farm Pty Ltd (ACN 100 815 414) ran both 'Squirrel Internet' and 'Ozenetcom Internet' as trading names from 1 Jul 2002. Acquired by Chariot Ltd 1 Aug 2003 - Note 35 records it as 'Ozenetcom' ($241k); the directors' report calls it 'Squirrel Net (Brisbane, Queensland)'.

events.details: Registered in the 1997 IP Network Index as Squirrel Internet, 11 Quindus St, Wacol QLD - SQUIRREL1-AU 203.31.36.0-203.31.39.255 (contiguous /22); sibling blocks of Squirrel Software Technologies Pty Ltd (SQUIRRELSOFTWARE-AU 203.62.172/22, SQUIRRELSOFT-AU 203.18.50/24, SQUIRREL-AU 203.20.110-111, all at 11 Quindus St Wacol). squirrel.net.au captured from 2 Dec 1998 - 'Squirrel Internet ... Level 30, Riverside Centre, 123 Eagle St. Brisbane Qld 4000', running a live webcam of the Brisbane CBD with an online shopping portal.

events.details: Acquired by Chariot Ltd on 1 Aug 2003. Chariot's 2004 Annual Report Note 35 records it as 'Ozenetcom' (Internet Service Provider, 1 Aug 2003, $241k); the directors' report lists the same acquisition as 'Squirrel Net (Brisbane, Queensland)' - one deal, two names. Announced publicly 8 Aug 2003 with Blue Pin Internet (SMH). Operator The It Farm Pty Ltd (ACN 100 815 414) held the SQUIRREL INTERNET business name 01 Jul 2002 - 01 Sep 2003; continued as Hot Shot Hosting from 15 Sep 2004. squirrel.net.au is a Chariot netconnect customer mail domain by the 25 Mar 2005 portal capture.
